area.name: Ghamadan / King of Bahrain Forest Perimeter

area.description: Published outdoor road/dirt circuit around Ghamadan attractions, starting near sports fields. Shared roads require traffic awareness; no continuous sidewalk or traffic-free route guaranteed. Excludes forest interior, zoo and paid attractions.

area.description: General-public park paths and documented jogging provision in Al-Muqabalain. Running limited pending a current track-condition assessment; surface and slope unknown. Excludes women-only zone, booked courts and museum interiors; check park opening conditions.
